name: Snappt
positioning: A credit check does not catch a forged pay stub. This does.
description: Snappt analyses documents submitted with rental applications — pay stubs, bank statements — for signs of digital tampering, and cross-checks income against verified sources. It is bought as a layer on top of conventional screening rather than as a replacement for it.
real_estate_use: Document fraud is the failure mode conventional screening misses: an applicant with thin credit submits an edited pay stub, passes the income test, and defaults in month three. Multifamily operators run every application file through fraud detection before approval, and measure the product on bad-debt reduction rather than on approval speed.
features: Digital tampering detection on pay stubs and bank statements
Income verification against connected financial sources
Fraud risk scoring per application file
Reporting on fraud rates by property and by lead source
Audit trail supporting a defensible denial

use_cases.job: Catch forged income documents before approving a lease
Reduce bad debt by measuring fraud rates per property and per lead source
